value.message: Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim, Saturdays 9:00-9:30 a.m., Sept 12 to Nov 28, ages 3-5 without a parent in the water - their site says, though the fee isn't listed until the current Recreation Guide posts. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you when the price is up.
